descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S19 Live Ask AI in Nursing Home on the fallback path: Haiku forced to fail, Mistral answers, the log row names both and keeps the vendor's time

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 Every AI call (pre-round summary, note generation, billing, Ask AI, photo capture, handoff) logs its total time and, separately, the time the AI provider itself took, and which model answered (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9; TFA-94514 AC 7)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Local stack with BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL set to the Haiku id (the seam in bedrock.invoke fails every Haiku call as a 429 before it leaves the process), set and always removed by a local-only wrapper, for this batch only; fresh ask-ai account; Nursing Home resident with no labs on file

When Ask 'What labs are on file for this resident?'

Then The askChart aiCallLog row has fellBackFrom = the Haiku id, model = Mistral Large 3, providerMs > 0 and <= durationMs, and providerMs >= the Mistral attempt's time from the Convex log ('retries and a fallback add up'); the ai_disclosure audit row has the same provider_ms, model and fell_back_from; the answer says no labs are available; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.3 + 3.5 + 3.9 + TFA-94514 AC 7 on the slow path the split exists for (OAT-03 step 6: Haiku -> Mistral). Decided by the providerSplit check (R7) plus fellBackFrom and model; saysNone / noLabValue are sanity checks. The Nursing Home normal path runs through the same aiAction wrapper as S18. …

Where it ran: dev; test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
